description.content: Retrieves published CMS content from the specified delivery channel. Returns content items matching the specified content type and optional filters. Used for headless content delivery to external applications and decoupled frontends.

Comma-separated list of content keys to retrieve
Comma-separated list of managed content record IDs
Comma-separated list of topic names to filter content
Whether to return absolute URLs for media references
Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)
